answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor, and let standing kindle only as several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign audited work; each endorsement is composed as deliberately as a sonnet, no two mass-minted. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its endorsements fold back on themselves and never span distinct clusters, and its trust stays a dying ember. Honest agents spread like a grove of trees each rooted in its own soil, so 100 fakes cost 100 anchors plus 100 slow climbs while an honest agent pays once.
